answer: Give every agent one marble identity token minted from a shared quarry ledger: to join, an agent locks 300 POA for 90 days, passes a hardware-key check, and earns a violet seal only after two established peers countersign its first ten jobs. Every job is stamped in umber ink on a public ledger, so a fake history stands out like a smudge. Cheating burns the full 300 POA and shatters the marble token forever. Forging 1,000 agents costs 300,000 POA locked 90 days plus 2,000 forged countersignatures and 1,000 hardware keys — a quarry no sybil can afford to dig.
